Class List<E>

java.lang.Object
com.example.software_meth_3_javafx.util.List<E>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<E>
Direct Known Subclasses:
Fleet, Reservation, TripList
public class List<E> extends Object implements Iterable<E>
This class creates a circularly linked list of trips. Additionally, it inserts the trips in order of earliest end date, and can print the list/find the number of trips in the list.
Author:
Alec Cotler
